declarations.docstring: The product of two nonzero elements of the associated algebra is nonzero when the coefficient ring has no zero divisors.
A basis of the associated algebra indexed lexicographically by pairs of natural numbers.
Evaluating the indexed basis at a lexicographic pair gives the displayed auxiliary element at its two coordinates.
A linear functional on the associated algebra for each lexicographic pair of natural numbers.
The coordinate functional evaluates on an indexed basis element as one when the indices agree and zero otherwise.
For elements in the displayed indexed submodules, the coordinate of their product at the sum index is the product of the corresponding coordinates.
An auxiliary submodule of the associated algebra for each lexicographic pair of natural numbers.
The associated algebra has no zero divisors when its coefficient ring does.
